authors: N. Beisert, C. Kristjansen, M. Staudacher
title: The dilatation operator of conformal N=4 super Yang-Mills theory
claim: Systematic dilatation-operator approach: one-loop operator for general non-derivative scalar states, two-loop operator for pure scalar states (many new two-loop anomalous dimensions, single/multi-trace mixing subtleties, two-loop protected-operator checks, non-planar two-loop BMN results); planar three-loop contribution determined under the explicit assumption that integrability extends beyond two loops.
scheme: field-theory input at one and two loops (regularization details not verified from full text); three-loop part fixed by symmetry/integrability assumptions
symmetry_argument: conformal symmetry and structure of Feynman diagrams; three loops: assumed integrability (and BMN scaling, per later literature)

assumed: integrability beyond two loops for the three-loop planar operator
checked_partially: three-loop prediction later confirmed by EJS (S1a.23), KLOV (S1a.18) and Sieg's full superspace computation (S1a.07)

evidence: Abstract (paraphrased; one short quote on the three-loop assumption seen on the abstract page)
red_flags: three-loop operator is an assumption-based prediction (verified only later)
